[LSER.10.6] **Series cursor and companion-slot sugar.** A
cursor (`binding`, `binding.label`, `binding.slot`, or
`binding.slot.label`) identifies the (slot, observation,
backing) triple to access. Companion-slot form
`cursor.<agg>` and expression form `<agg>(cursor)` are
fully equivalent. See [LSER.6].
